messages:
Iris Chen: Quick thread on component library tweaks — buttons, table density, toasts, and a11y nits. Found three things while QAing the dashboard: focus ring low contrast on dark header, small buttons in compact rows look bulky, and toasts disappear too fast for screen reader users. Can we iterate? :mag:
Samir Patel: Yep. I'll prototype compact spacing tokens and stronger focus styles. Pushing a WIP branch shortly.
Samir Patel: Token proposal in the branch:
```css
:root {
  --spacing-compact: 8px;
  --row-height-compact: 32px;
  --btn-padding-compact: 6px 12px;
  --focus-ring-width: 3px;
  --color-primary-dark: #0f2b66;
}
```
Marta Ruiz: Accessibility checklist: 1) Ensure focus ring contrast meets WCAG (4.5:1 for text). 2) Make toast default 6000ms or provide persistent option. 3) Use `aria-live="polite"` and ensure focus management when toasts are triggered by keyboard.
DesignBot: a11y-scan: `button--primary` contrast 3.9:1. Recommendation: darker background or increased font weight.
Leo Grant: For the routes table, reduce horizontal cell padding 16->12px and add compact row-height token. Watch badge wrapping and truncation.
Iris Chen: I'll update Figma tokens: spacing-compact=8px, row-height-compact=32px, btn-padding-compact=6px 12px. Focus: 3px box-shadow with outline fallback. Will attach screenshots in the doc.
Samir Patel: I'll update CSS vars, add browser fallbacks, and expose toast API: `toast({ message, durationMs?: number | 'persistent' })` with default 6000ms.
Marta Ruiz: UX copy nit: standardize modal actions: use "Confirm" for destructive actions (explain consequence) and "Save" for state changes. Ensure modal close button is first in tab order.
Samir Patel: PR updated: primary -> #0f2b66, focus ring 3px, added compact tokens, default toast 6000ms. CI reported a visual diff on primary hover - need design sign-off.
Iris Chen: For hover use primary-600 slightly darker. I'll post hexes from Figma.
Leo Grant: After merge I'll run layout regression with long names/badges. Compact spacing may affect truncation.
Marta Ruiz: Please run axe on staging and a keyboard-only manual pass before rollout. Tag me when ready.
Samir Patel: Will open staging PR and tag @Marta for the axe run.
Iris Chen: Thanks team 44d I'll update spec and attach screenshots here when ready.
